REINVENT THE WAREHOUSE®. REIMAGINE THE SUPPLY CHAIN®.

Organizing and orchestrating the movement of goods
in our physical world

Symbotic Solutions are changing the way goods move through the supply chain. With Symbotic, the brightest minds are innovating highly effective, robust, and flexible robotic solutions to keep facilities ahead of the rapidly changing needs of the supply chain – and leading the advent of AI software that expands operational possibilities.

TOTAL WAREHOUSE AUTOMATION

The Symbotic Solution

Symbotic Systems are complete, end-to-end warehouse automation solutions that have the power to increase your facility’s capacity through dense storage, maximize throughput with streamlined operations, and create efficiency gains throughout your supply chain with AI-enhanced software that sees beyond your warehouse walls.

NATIVE CASE HANDLING

Solutions for Warehouse & Distribution

Distribution facilities automatically manage unlimited SKU volume from door-to-door while gaining predictive inventory management capabilities and downstream efficiency gains.

Goods are stored in their native cases within a fully secured system, on shelves with just enough clear space for each case without the need for totes or trays.

LEARN MORE

LESS-THAN-CASE HANDLING

Solutions for
Micro-Fulfillment

Each-pick and low unit of measure operations are optimized for fast order fulfillment through the SymMicro System.

Goods are decanted into the SymMicro System, loose in totes, optimized for picking. Totes are automatically retrieved from storage by SymBots and presented to an ergonomic pick station where an operator fulfills multiple orders simultaneously.

SymMicro Systems are flexible and can be adapted for larger facilities or used in the back of retail stores. They are tri-zone temperature capable, allowing ambient, refrigerated, and frozen goods to be managed within a single solution.

LEARN MORE

TRANSFORM YOUR SUPPLY CHAIN

Solutions for All Industries

Symbotic Solutions are highly flexible and can be adapted for almost any industry where palletized goods, small quantity fulfillment, or omnichannel operations are run. Goods as small as 1 lb (0.5 kg) and 2 x 6.4 x 5 in (5.1 x 16.3 x 12.7 cm) to as large as 60 lb (27.2 kg) and 36 x 24 x 16.2 in (91.4 x 61 x 41.2 cm) can be automatically managed and fulfilled in their native packaging. Loose items with an even wider size range and with cold chain requirements have effective automation options with Symbotic.

ABOUT SYMBOTIC

What Makes Symbotic a Different Kind of Company

All-in-One Solution Provider & Technology Innovator

Typical integrators are limited by their portfolio of technology partnerships and are unable to resolve problems when those technologies misalign. At Symbotic, we provide complete, turnkey-ready, end-to-end warehouse automation, and as the software and key robotic innovator for each solution, we can provide solutions to best meet customer needs without limitations.

Turning Focused R&D into Customer-Centric Solutions

To date, we have invested over $1 billion into research and development, resulting in 1,050+ patents issued or pending in over 15 countries around the world. We are deeply dedicated to innovating meaningful and effective technology that keeps pace with ever-evolving changes in the supply chain, to give our customers a leading edge.

American Owned, Operated, & Innovated

Founded by Rick Cohen with headquarters in Wilmington (MA), USA, our team provides local support and understands complex supply chain challenges via deep first-hand experience. Symbotic’s research and development teams, located around the US, draw from the world’s leading innovative minds to pioneer groundbreaking technologies that are defining the future of material handing and supply chain solutions.

Dedicated to Technology that Betters the Supply Chain

Symbotic is not only the leader in industrial automation, but in technology at large— innovating solutions through robotics and AI for the betterment of material access. Our purpose is to get the right goods to people who need them, when they need them, and our innovations in robotics and material handling logistics pursue that mission.

Award-Winning Innovation

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

Performance Cookies

These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

Functional Cookies

These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

Targeting Cookies

These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
